source.notes: The official Flinders scholarship page states an explicit calendar deadline of 18 June 2026 (ACST) for the 2027 HDR Annual Scholarship Round - International, with an opening date of 30 April 2026. Both the structured 'Closing date' field (18-06-2026) and the prose sentence agree. However, 18 June 2026 is in the past relative to the retrieval date of 2026-10-05, while the record is flagged verification_status=active (open/upcoming). Per brief section 6 this is an expired_mismatch: the stale date is deliberately NOT written and has NOT been silently rolled forward to 2027. The award is annual, so a future 2028 HDR round will exist, but the page publishes no later closing date, so no upcoming date can be established. Applicant must also lodge an HDR admission application before the scholarship application.

source.notes: The official scholarship page does state a closing date, but it is relative rather than calendar-based: '2 weeks upon invitation to apply'. Applicants are only invited after accepting an earlier offer: 'Upon a successful offer of place into the applicant's chosen programme(s) of study, eligible candidates will be invited to apply and provide further information for consideration for this award.' Because the deadline is anchored to an individually-issued invitation with no calendar anchor, no calendar date is derivable and this is deliberately NOT recorded as EXACT, MONTH or ROLLING (the page never says rolling or anytime). The 2-week response window is recorded verbatim in deadline_display so the information is not lost. Outcome is therefore unknown with precision unknown, per the rule that a plausible invention is worse than a truthful UNKNOWN.

source.raw_extract:
**Detailed information and the application timeline** for requesting an application fee waiver as part of the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program eligibility process will be published on this page **shortly**.

**Applications for the fee waiver will be open from October to mid-December 2026.**
source.exact_deadline_wording: Applications for the fee waiver will be open from October to mid-December 2026.
source.notes: The official Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program page at Sciences Po explicitly states that the application timeline will be published 'shortly', i.e. the programme's own application deadline has NOT been published. The only timing statement on the page is a month-level window for the application FEE WAIVER (a prerequisite eligibility step, not the scholarship application deadline): 'Applications for the fee waiver will be open from October to mid-December 2026.' That window is recorded verbatim but is not promoted to the record's deadline, because it describes a different step and no day is given. Verified on the official Sciences Po admissions deadlines calendar, which lists 'Mastercard Scholarship' under 'Scholarships deadlines' but only links back to this same programme page and gives no date, stating instead: 'If you are applying for a Boutmy or Mastercard scholarship for your two-year master's programme at Sciences Po, you must submit your application before the deadline of the scholarship, regardless of the selected programmes.' The 21 February 2027 closing date published on that calendar is the deadline for the two-year Master's programme international admissions procedure, NOT the scholarship deadline, and per brief section 5 a generic admissions deadline for a different procedure must not be used as evidence here. Result: truthful UNKNOWN.

summary.notes: Zero deadline_date values were written for this shard. That is deliberate: the three Otago Entrance Scholarships (257, 258, 408) publish only year-less recurring month/day timing (ANNUAL), the two Otago postgraduate awards (409, 410) explicitly accept applications at any time (ROLLING), record 203's only published closing date (18 June 2026) had already passed at retrieval time so it is an expired_mismatch rather than an upcoming date, record 259's deadline is relative to an individually-issued invitation ('2 weeks upon invitation to apply'), and record 355's programme page states its application timeline will be published 'shortly' so no deadline exists yet. No date was invented for any MONTH-level value and no ROLLING/ANNUAL value was converted into a calendar date. One shard source URL was dead (408, HTTP 404) and a live equivalent on the same official domain was used.
